critique.evidence: Desktop and mobile clearly state the core contrast—“The signature is valid. The intent was stolen.”—then support it with an intent-to-payment sequence and a prominent “FOLLOW THE PAYMENT” action. However, at the tablet viewport the persistent navigation overlaps and obscures the first headline line, so the complete claim cannot be read cleanly without reconstruction. “OPEN EVALUATION SCOPE” is also less self-explanatory than the primary action.
critique.fix: Fix the tablet breakpoint by collapsing the navigation or reserving enough header space so the full headline remains unobstructed. Rename the secondary CTA to state its destination or outcome, such as “VIEW EVALUATION CRITERIA.”
